text: For past writable unacknowledged DISPLAY alarms, showMissed fires and continues to the next alarm. With that preference off, the accepted code converts optional start/end bounds and fires when either is at or after now. Events use startDate/endDate; tasks use entryDate/dueDate. One missing bound does not discard the other, and the branch is broader than an ongoing-event test. Preserve per-alarm continuation and the later notification work. Current acknowledgment additions are separate later source. No date, alarm or UI test ran.
title: Missed-alarm handling can use either optional item date bound
